Item: Daily Normal Maximum Temperature, Daily Normal Minimum Temperature, Daily Normal Rainfall, Monthly Humidity Normal Data, Monthly Maximum Temperature, Monthly Minimum Temperature, Normal Monthly Rainfall, Normal Monthly Rainy Day, Normal Wind Speed
What it holds: Long term normal values: daily and monthly normal maximum and minimum temperature, normal rainfall, normal rainy days, normal humidity and normal wind speed
Why it is excluded: Excluded by decision. A normal is an average over a thirty year reference period, not a measurement of a particular month. The approved climate relations are keyed by year and month, so a normal has no year to occupy. Loading a normal beside a measured value would also mean two different kinds of number in the same column, and a query could not tell them apart.

What it holds: One row per measured quantity, with its unit of measurement
Why it is excluded: The unit depends only on the measure, so Second Normal Form requires lifting it out. The approved diagram draws no unit entity, so the units are documented rather than loaded. Item: Rows refused by a primary key, exact duplicates
What it holds: A second organisation publishing exactly the value another organisation had already published for the same key
Why it is excluded: Boyce Codd Normal Form enforces the key, so only one row per key can load. These rows agree to the last decimal place with the row that is kept, so nothing measurable is lost and they are not listed individually. They are counted here so that the arithmetic from Third Normal Form to the loaded database closes.

Item: Measurements refused by a primary key, values disagreeing
What it holds: A second organisation publishing a different value for a key another organisation had already filled
Why it is excluded: Climate precedence is Bangladesh Meteorological Department, then Bangladesh Rice Research Institute, then Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics. Equal sources use the newest coverage, then the later source occurrence. Of these, 37145 are a real disagreement about the value and 2446 are the same reading rounded to a different number of decimal places. Every one is listed with both values in csv/BCNF/_Key_Conflicts.csv, so no rejected measurement is lost in silence. Together with the exact duplicates above this accounts for all 86176 rows the key refuses.
